title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 048
review_goal: Differentiate camcorder, candy, and cash variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Concentric camera lens ring with one inner circle inside one outer circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple lens or record ring made from concentric circles.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the handheld camcorder when the body, grip, and cord should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the camera idea to a plain two ring lens circle.

items.depicts_observation: Wrapped candy shape with an oval center and one twisted end on left and right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic wrapped sweet with pointed twist ends.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round candy when the top corners should look crimped instead of side wrapped.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot places a small oval candy center between two pointed wrapper ends.

items.depicts_observation: Round wrapped candy with two crimped top corners and one inner shine mark
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round candy wrapper with crimped top corners above the sweet.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the side wrapped candy when the ends should point left and right.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot makes the candy round and lifts the wrapper folds to the top corners.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangular banknote with four corner tabs and one centered circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a flat banknote with decorative corner tabs and a center seal.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the wavy banknote when the outer edges should curve like fabric.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the note flat and marks each corner with a folded tab shape.

items.depicts_observation: Wavy banknote with one centered circle and one curved top edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a soft waving banknote shape instead of a stiff rectangular bill.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flat note with corner tabs when the edges should stay straight.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot bends the banknote edges into one wave while keeping the center seal.
